skillFull: Creates stone scales and shoots them off at certain intervals. While shooting stone scales, Energy Drain is reduced. When a stone scale collides with something it shatters, creating Scale Gem Jellies. Level Up for more points for Scale Gem Jellies.
story: Local Folklore claims that the salty and sugary sweat shed by generations of monks training at the halite Monastery tricked down into the Halite Gorge, pooling drop by drop into a small and ancient spring. One day, Pangolith emerged from the spring's depths. Each scale carries within it the weight of long and grueling training, absorbed over countless ages. With eyes kept shut, it witnesses none of the world's wickedness. With its ironclad body, it rolls itself around the very suffering and anguish of all living things, preventing it from seeping further out into the world. Pangolith has become a mainstay of various legends and fables, for the Pet is seen as a single drop of the sweetest dew in a bitter world of dust—a guardian deity for all those who have been weighed down by the forces of evil!

costumes.name: Forged Beyond Breaking
costumes.info: Pangolith's training never ceases, even as its entire body is honed to be harder than the hardest steel gauntlets. Each individual scale is engraved in remembrance of a different being's pain and suffering. Perhaps the weight of taking on all this pain as its own is what caused its indestructible form to shimmer with enlightenment in even the dimmest places.
